findings.statement: Shared generic nonuse reasons omit material competing mechanisms and a concrete scope failure.
findings.evidence_type: independent artifact and original-record fidelity audit; no participant outcomes
findings.supported_actor_task: Product Lead editing the exact final pressure-test packet for product decisions
findings.conditions: L056 is partial/vendor evidence; L020/L021 are individual HN reports. Mandate is not preference, but can serve a legitimate coverage objective. Cost-table scope is not shown to be statically mapped.
findings.strongest_supported_case: Both mappings demote CW-L020/L021/L056 and CW-Z002 to generic context/nonuse. L020 reports satisfactory internal per-repo review and retains human knowledge sharing; L021 explains centralized review because local execution cannot be assumed. L056 describes coordination, re-review and recovery implemented internally. Z002 reports a model-name/pricing dependency failure plus successful lexical migration, directly relevant to the claimed consumer-scope job.
findings.strongest_countercase: Y005/Y012 already preserve strong internal/PR alternatives; neither synthesis claims exhaustive external research. These additional accounts are self-reports/vendor or AI-coauthored cases and do not prove accuracy, Codeweb demand or superiority.

findings.statement: The final local decision rule must reconcile quality benefit with effort, rather than collapse them into a slogan.
findings.evidence_type: independent artifact and original-record fidelity audit; no participant outcomes
findings.supported_actor_task: Product Lead editing the exact final pressure-test packet for product decisions
findings.conditions: Tests remain unexecuted proposals; exact scoring/allocation still needs pre-registration before an authorized experiment.
findings.strongest_supported_case: SA-C02 requires changed decisions at acceptable total effort; SB-C04 calls for a correct changed decision at lower total burden. SB-T01 allows correct additional decision or net burden improvement. The original sprint permits two additional useful findings with no higher median effort, while requiring case-level adverse outcomes. These are not identical pass rules.
findings.strongest_countercase: Both drafts demand capable controls, independent adjudication, all costs and null outcomes; both explicitly preserve the original gate as provisional. This is an editorial ambiguity, not demonstrated contradictory customer evidence.
